subject: Hero experiment and trial SKU copy for AWS Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing - hero messaging + trial SKU questions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As we prep the final AWS Marketplace product page for Acme Cloud's new integration, the product team asked us to validate two things before we go live:

1) Hero messaging variants — we want to A/B test two short hero lines (one focused on cost savings and one on latency). I attached two PNG variants (hero_variants_v2.png) and a short doc with proposed one-liners. Can Redwood confirm which variant aligns with the co-sell pitch?

2) Trial SKU configuration — AWS needs a small CSV with trial SKUs and durations for their onboarding workflow. Attached a draft (trial-sku-matrix.csv). Are there any Redwood constraints (minimum trial length, billing hooks) we should be aware of?

Also copied aws-marketplace-ops to flag any AMI or entitlement requirements that would block a short trial.

Goal: finalize copy and SKU table by EOD Thursday (Apr 13) so we can submit the offer for review next week.

Thanks — let me know if you want a quick call.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Partner PM — Acme Cloud Solutions
sofia@acmecloud.com

Attachments: hero_variants_v2.png (image), trial-sku-matrix.csv (text)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing - hero messaging + trial SKU questions

Sofia — thanks for the clear note and attachments. Looping in Kimberly (copy lead) and Jordan (marketplace ops) to confirm what we can support from the Redwood side.

Quick notes from me:
- We prefer hero messaging that calls out a concrete benefit (e.g., "Reduce inference cost by up to 3x") rather than generic claims. That said, any latency-focused line that ties to a measurable SLA or latency percentile is OK for co-sell.
- Trial constraints: Redwood Hosted API supports time-limited trials and usage-limited trials. From a Marketplace SKU perspective, a 14-day time-limited trial is straightforward. We can also enforce token caps if you'd like usage limits.

Kimberly — could you review the two hero lines in the attached doc (aws_listing_draft_v3.docx) and suggest tweaks for length/claim language? Jordan — do you see any AMI/entitlement items the aws ops team will flag?

If we can get copy by EOD Thursday, I’ll consolidate and send the final offer package. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

Thanks for pulling this in, Rafael. I reviewed the doc and the PNGs — nice work. High-level edit notes below (I attached an annotated copy of aws_listing_draft_v3.docx with line edits):

- Hero headlines: shorten to 7–9 words for mobile; avoid percentages unless backed by a short footnote. Suggested pair:
  • Variant A (cost): "Cut inference costs with efficient batching"
  • Variant B (latency): "Real-time LLM responses under 200ms p99"

- Subhead/subcopy: prefer explicit callouts for deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Example: "Available as Hosted API, Dedicated pools, or Private VPC deployment."

- CTA language: for A/B, use the same CTA to avoid conversion noise — recommend "Start free trial" for both variants.

- Trial SKU matrix: 14-day trial + 100k token cap looks good. We should add a note: "Trial does not include Dedicated capacity—contact sales for Dedicated evaluation."

Jordan — confirm AMI/entitlement notes (I flagged two items where we might need marketplace-accepted AMI naming).

Sofia — if these work, I can apply the edits and return a clean copy by EOD Wednesday.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Product Copywriter, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx (annotated)

Kimberly / Rafael — this is great, thank you. Confirming the following so we can move to offer submission: 

- We will use the latency variant for the initial A/B landing test: "Real-time LLM responses under 200ms p99" with CTA "Start free trial".
- Trial SKU: 14 days, 100k token cap; add the note that Dedicated evaluation is via sales lead only — that’s fine.
- AWS ops: we’ll update the AMI metadata per Jordan’s note (Jordan, once you confirm exact naming, we’ll push a final AMI manifest).

Can you return the finalized doc and PNGs (exported at 72dpi web-ready) by EOD tomorrow? Once we have the files I’ll create the Marketplace offer draft and route for AWS review.

If everything is green, our timeline stays on track to submit the listing on Monday April 17.

Thanks again — looping in aws-marketplace-ops for visibility.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
